DitherInput.placeholder: Shown while the field is empty.
DitherInput.label: A label above the field.
DitherInput.description: Muted help text below the field.
DitherInput.error: An error below the field. Turns it red.
DitherInput.icon: An image before the text, such as a magnifier for search.
DitherInput.password: Hides the text and adds a show and hide button.
DitherInput.clearable: A clear button while there is text. Escape clears too.
DitherInput.color: Colour of the tint, floor and focus edge.
DitherInput.bloom: A soft glow in the colour while focused.
DitherInput.enabled: Drops to 45% opacity and ignores input when false.
DitherInput.edited: Called with the new text on every change.
DitherInput.accepted: Called with the text when Enter is pressed.
DitherInput.cleared: Called when the clear button empties the field.
